sgvo_man_02_project_copy.notable_text: The project/reserved copy says sphere weighing is preferably performed after sales close. This is corroborative only and not treated as the current controlling manual.

sgvo_pro_05_sequence.policy_9: Automatic sales close is 15:00 for De las Tres and 21:00 for nocturnal draws; changes require authorized approval and institutional notice.
sgvo_pro_05_sequence.activity_3_1: Before the Cierre de Venta section, confirm draw number and planned sphere case with SEGOB inspector and Lotería Nacional representative.
sgvo_pro_05_sequence.activity_4_1: SICAL screen must show betting status Cerrado; date, time, draw number and sales are checked; printed sumario is initialled.
sgvo_pro_05_sequence.activity_5_1: The next procedure section is Pesaje y Colocación de las Esferas; spheres are weighed one by one after the Cierre de Venta section.
sgvo_pro_05_sequence.activities_5_3_to_5_5: If weight is unacceptable, notify representatives, change sphere case and return to activity 4.1; if acceptable, sign the weighing strip and attach it to the Act.
sgvo_pro_05_sequence.policy_30: Recording covers the process from sphere weighing through the electronic draw; edited draw recording forms part of the Act.
sgvo_pro_05_sequence.implication: The public current procedure orders the same-draw weighing after the SICAL sales-close activity. It does not support V317's requirement that same-draw masses be available before close under the normal sequence.

sgaf_int_48_sical_chain.document_name: Instructivo del Servicio Integral de Captación de Apuestas en Línea (SICAL)
key_points_from_scanned_pages: After automatic sales close, SICAL sends a firma MD5 for each participation file to Lotería Nacional and stores the files on designated servers.
For 13:00, 15:00, 17:00 and 19:00 draws, sales files and MD5 are copied to contingency server alongside the draws.
For 21:00 draws, sales files and MD5 are copied from production to contingency server the following day, then loaded and checked.
sgaf_int_48_sical_chain.custody_caveat: No contest-specific SICAL sumario, participation/cancellation file, MD5 record, production/contingency transfer log or independently timestamped close event was obtained in this run. MD5 is preserved as the procedure's named integrity mechanism, not represented as a modern collision-resistant digest.

fixture.procedure_compatibility: NOT_ESTABLISHED; public procedure places weighing after SICAL close activity
